title: Inf Stamina, ESP, All Evidence GUI, Unkillable & More!
features:
✨Features/Toggles v1.8:
- Fullbright
- Infinite Stamina
- ESP (Ghost, Ghost Room, Cursed Items, Boo Boo Doll, Players)
- ALL Evidence GUI / Auto ALL Evidence (EMF, SB, Temp, Orbs, UV, SLS, Writing)
- Ghost Info GUI
- Safe TP (Teleports you out when the ghost is hunting)
- Safe TP Activation Distance (Customizable)
- Sprint Speed (Customizable)
- ESP Hiding Spots (Might not work on some maps)
- Remove All Hiding Spot's Blockages
- NoClip Doors
- Manual TP & Save TP Position (with Keybinds)
- Notify Ghost Hunting
- Manual Unkillable (with Keybind)
- Auto Unkillable (Customizable Activation Distance)
- Save Config
- Remove Jumpscare
- ESP Inventory
